#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Self-tests for csv-insights main.py."""

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
MAIN = os.path.join(HERE, "main.py")


def _run(args, stdin=None):
    return subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, MAIN] + args,
        input=stdin,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        cwd=HERE,
    )


class _TmpFile:
    def __init__(self, content):
        self.fd, self.path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".csv", dir=HERE)
        with os.fdopen(self.fd, "w", newline="") as f:
            f.write(content)

    def __enter__(self):
        return self.path

    def __exit__(self, *exc):
        os.unlink(self.path)


class TestBasic(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_simple_csv_json(self):
        data = "name,age\nAlice,30\nBob,25\n"
        with _TmpFile(data) as p:
            r = _run([p])
            self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
            out = json.loads(r.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(out, [{"name": "Alice", "age": "30"}, {"name": "Bob", "age": "25"}])

    def test_quoted_commas(self):
        data = 'name,note\n"Smith, John",hello\n'
        with _TmpFile(data) as p:
            r = _run([p])
            self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
            out = json.loads(r.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(out, [{"name": "Smith, John", "note": "hello"}])

    def test_embedded_newline(self):
        data = 'name,note\n"Line1\nLine2",ok\n'
        with _TmpFile(data) as p:
            r = _run([p])
            self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
            out = json.loads(r.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(out, [{"name": "Line1\nLine2", "note": "ok"}])


class TestFilters(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_where_single(self):
        data = "region,sales\nUS,100\nEU,200\nUS,50\n"
        with _TmpFile(data) as p:
            r = _run([p, "--where", "region=US"])
            self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
            out = json.loads(r.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(len(out), 2)
            for row in out:
                self.assertEqual(row["region"], "US")

    def test_where_multiple_and(self):
        data = "region,cat,sales\nUS,A,100\nUS,B,200\nEU,A,50\n"
        with _TmpFile(data) as p:
            r = _run([p, "--where", "region=US", "--where", "cat=A"])
            self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
            out = json.loads(r.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(out, [{"region": "US", "cat": "A", "sales": "100"}])

    def test_where_exact_string(self):
        data = "v,n\n01,1\n1,2\n"
        with _TmpFile(data) as p:
            r = _run([p, "--where", "v=01"])
            self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
            out = json.loads(r.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(out, [{"v": "01", "n": "1"}])


class TestAggregate(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sum_grouped(self):
        data = "cat,amt\nA,10\nB,20\nA,30\n"
        with _TmpFile(data) as p:
            r = _run([p, "--group-by", "cat", "--sum", "amt"])
            self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
            out = json.loads(r.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(out, [
                {"cat": "A", "sum_amt": "40"},
                {"cat": "B", "sum_amt": "20"},

            out = json.loads(r.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(out, [{"cat": "A", "sum_amt": "40", "avg_amt": "20"}])

    def test_decimal_formatting(self):
        data = "cat,amt\nA,0.01\nA,0.02\nA,0.07\n"
        with _TmpFile(data) as p:
            r = _run([p, "--group-by", "cat", "--sum", "amt"])
